_comment: Real facades around Trg bana Jelačića, photographed in Google Street View through the user's Chrome (tool/sv_*.py) and turned into straight-on elevations by gen-image (tool/prepare_facades.py). frame = .art/streetview/frames/<frame>.jpg; crop = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in that 1568x718 frame; edges = OSM footprint edges (building id _e edge index) the facade covers, in order along the facade; storeys counts the floors up to the cornice; source says which imagery.

facades.name: interwar_nw_corner
facades.look: a 1930s interwar modernist office block: pale grey-beige stone-clad upper floors with regular rectangular windows, a darker grey stone two-storey base with tall shop windows and square piers, a thin balcony band above the base, the top floor set back

facades.name: kuca_popovic_front
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (kuca_popovic redraw with the corner tower cut off; the tower is kuca_popovic_tower)
facades.look: the flat square front of a 1930s interwar apartment house painted salmon-orange: three window axes, a projecting block over the first and second floors, a recessed loggia with four square pilasters and thin railings on the third floor, a set-back top floor with three windows, a cream awning over the ground-floor shop

facades.name: kuca_popovic_tower
facades.place: the corner of Trg bana Jelačića and Splavnica
facades.source: Street View Jul 2025 (Splavnica pano 8Wp3h1kAKQS-_wvB60d0iQ), Jul 2024 and a Nov 2022 photosphere from the square
facades.look: UNROLLED ROUNDED CORNER TOWER of the same 1930s salmon-orange interwar house, drawn as ONE flat rectangular elevation as if the round tower were unrolled onto a plane: the LEFT third is the tower's flat west face on Splavnica, the middle is the curved part, the RIGHT third faces the square. The three photos show it from Splavnica (left panel: the west side), from the square (middle and right panels: the south side). Left third: a big shoe-shop window with rows of white sneakers on shelves at ground level with a small red-and-white sale sticker, above it a white-framed three-pane bay (oriel) window on the first floor, a strip of bare pale grey render beside it. Middle and right: two CURVED concrete balconies with thin horizontal tube railings running round the tower on the second and third floors, each with a tall glazed balcony door; on the fourth floor two cream-yellow carved stone RELIEF PANELS of figures on either side of a window, and a patch of flaking grey plaster below them; the fifth (top) floor is a curved band of six white casement windows under a thin projecting round cornice cap; horizontal grooves in the render between; the ground floor on the square side has a narrow shop window/door with a small white memorial plaque beside it. Smooth salmon-orange render, no text except the plaque. Leave out the street lamp, people and umbrellas

facades.name: popovic_splavnica
facades.source: Street View Jul 2025 (Splavnica pano 8Wp3h1kAKQS-_wvB60d0iQ), rectified with tool/sv_rectify.py
facades.look: the long Splavnica side of the same 1930s salmon-orange interwar apartment house (Kuća Popović), smooth render, white-framed windows. LEFT panel: a rectified straight-on photo of the lower floors (flat grey = unknown); RIGHT panel: the same wall seen from below, showing the upper floors and the top. Draw it left to right as: (1) a narrow projecting block at the left with single windows per floor; (2) a wide RECESSED middle section, three window axes, with long straight concrete balconies with thin horizontal tube railings across all three axes on the second, third and fourth floors, a top floor set back behind a white glass balustrade, plain windows on the first floor and dark shop windows with shoe displays on the ground floor; (3) on the right a projecting block with groups of three tall narrow windows (one wide between two narrow) on the second to fifth floors, a white-framed three-pane bay (oriel) window on the first floor, a shoe-shop window full of white sneakers on the ground floor, and at the far right a strip of bare pale grey render with a small red-framed white street sign reading 'SPLAVNICA'. Leave out the umbrellas, benches, lamp posts and people

facades.name: kuca_rado
facades.look: a 1905 Vienna Secession apartment house in pale grey and white render: three bays of angular bay windows with dark brown roller shutters, a grey rough-cast band on the lower floors, a pale green copper mansard with two white statues at the top, a large glazed café front on the ground floor

facades.name: harmica_yellow
facades.look: an 1890s neo-Baroque palace painted pale butter yellow with rich cream stucco ornament: two slightly projecting side bays crowned by curved Baroque gables with small copper domes, arched windows with ornate crowns on the second floor, small balconies, dormers in the roof, a ground floor of large dark shop windows between yellow pilasters with the arched passage 'Harmica' in the middle

facades.name: cream_corner_tower
facades.look: an 1880s historicist palace in cream and light stone colour: rich window surrounds with pediments, stone balconies on the first and second floors, rusticated ground floor with arched openings and modern shop fronts, a corner tower with a small dome at the right edge

facades.name: pink_arcades
facades.look: an 1880s historicist building with an old-rose pink upper facade and cream-coloured window surrounds with small pediments, three upper storeys of regular windows, and a cream rusticated ground floor that is an arcade of round arches

facades.name: gradska_stedionica
facades.look: the 1920s Gradska štedionica (city savings bank) palace: pale grey stone facade with regular windows, the large letters GRADSKA ŠTEDIONICA across the third floor, a heavy cornice, and a monumental ground floor with a colonnade of tall stone columns in front of a recessed arcade

facades.name: feller_stern_white
facades.look: a 1930s modernist block in plain white render with regular windows, a thin projecting balcony band with railings above the ground floor and an ochre band, the top floor set back, a ground floor of shop fronts with dark awnings

facades.name: octagon_windows
facades.look: a 1930s modernist building: beige render with regular white-framed windows on the upper floors, the top two floors stepped back, a distinctive band of five large octagonal windows set in grey rough stone with a diamond pattern above the shop floor, glazed shops at street level

facades.name: felbinger_panpek
facades.look: an early-19th-century classicist house in cream render with a brown tiled roof, simple rectangular windows with small cornices, a wrought-iron balcony in the middle above a round-arched central gateway, and a ground floor of round-arched shop openings

facades.name: salmon_pilasters
facades.source: Street View Aug 2011 (in 2024 it is wrapped in scaffolding)
facades.look: an 1880s historicist building in salmon pink render with cream pilasters and window surrounds, arched windows with balconies on the upper floors, a cream ground floor with shops

facades.name: grey_neoclassical
facades.look: a grey-white neoclassical palace with a giant order of columns spanning the two upper floors, a central pediment with statues on the corners, three tall round-arched windows with balconies in the middle, and a rusticated ground floor

facades.name: kuca_zivkovic
facades.look: a mid-19th-century historicist apartment house in brick-red (dusty terracotta) render with cream window surrounds, triangular pediments over the second-floor windows, a brown tiled roof, and a plain grey ground floor with shop doors

facades.name: kuca_cuk
facades.look: a narrow bright yellow apartment house with white window surrounds, a small balcony, oval ornament medallions between floors, a slate mansard roof with dormers, and a shop ground floor

facades.name: koncar_block
facades.look: a 1960s modernist commercial block with white horizontal bands and ribbon windows on five upper floors, a projecting glazed first floor, and a fully glazed shop ground floor

facades.name: allianz_white_corner
facades.look: a white historicist corner building with regular tall windows with simple surrounds, a cornice with a flat roof, and a ground floor of shop windows under a grey band

facades.name: kuca_stankovic
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024; raw.png hand-edited 2026-10-01: its east end, which gen-image had misread as a Hotel Dubrovnik entrance, is a third ZAKS bay copied from the one beside it (the original is raw_hotel_dubrovnik.png). Do not rerun generate on it
facades.look: a large 1880s historicist corner block with a red-brick-coloured upper facade and cream stone window surrounds, a rusticated cream ground floor with shops, a steep red tiled roof with a corner tower with a blue-grey dome
